compiled_state.title: Create receipt-parse.sh with RECEIPT_PARSE_ERROR halt-and-log semantics
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
- dd-4: Orchestrator-side receipt parser rejects malformed return blocks with RECEIPT_PARSE_ERROR surface, halts workflow
- dd-5: On RECEIPT_PARSE_ERROR orchestrator emits structured log with site id, sub-agent name, schema-mismatch reason, byte_count
- dd-6: On RECEIPT_PARSE_ERROR orchestrator escalates by halting workflow (no silent retry/forward), surfaces to human session
- dd-7: Receipt-only contract enforced — sub-agents must not embed full payload; violation produces RECEIPT_PARSE_ERROR

## Description
Create plugins/dso/scripts/receipt-parse.sh accepting return block on stdin + `--site-id <id>` + `--sub-agent <name>` flags. Parses receipt-only `<output_contract>` XML extracting SCRATCH_TICKET_ID and SCRATCH_KEY. Rejects malformed input by emitting `event=RECEIPT_PARSE_ERROR site_id=<id> sub_agent=<name> reason=<text> byte_count=<int>` to stderr and exiting non-zero. On valid input emits SCRATCH_TICKET_ID and SCRATCH_KEY to stdout, exit 0. Also create plugins/dso/docs/contracts/scratch-receipt-contract.md documenting the schema. Also create tests/scratch/test-receipt-parse.sh.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] bash tests/run-all.sh exits 0
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] Lint passes
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Malformed input: non-zero exit + RECEIPT_PARSE_ERROR log with all 4 fields
  Verify: bash tests/scratch/test-receipt-parse.sh
- [ ] Valid input: SCRATCH_TICKET_ID and SCRATCH_KEY emitted to stdout, exit 0
  Verify: bash tests/scratch/test-receipt-parse.sh
- [ ] Payload-embedded-in-return rejected
  Verify: bash tests/scratch/test-receipt-parse.sh
- [ ] receipt-parse.sh executable
  Verify: test -x plugins/dso/scripts/receipt-parse.sh
- [ ] Contract doc exists
  Verify: test -f plugins/dso/docs/contracts/scratch-receipt-contract.md

## File Impact
| Path | Action |
|---|---|
| plugins/dso/scripts/receipt-parse.sh | Create |
| plugins/dso/docs/contracts/scratch-receipt-contract.md | Create |
| tests/scratch/test-receipt-parse.sh | Create |

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 sonnet → opus → user.
